raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "push to"
      role subject "the config"
      role object "edge-lb-7"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "occur"
      role subject "the 503 spike"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t1 before|after ?t2
